hardware: Intel Core Ultra 7 255H; integrated Intel Graphics; 16,582,352,896 bytes RAM
toolchain: Rust 1.99.1; release thin LTO; Slint 1.18.1 winit/software; scale 1.5
method: Three fresh app processes, normal window, 3 synthetic H.264/yuv420p/30fps/3-second sources per process; ten positions per source; 100ms settling. No concurrent Cargo builds in retained runs; background desktop apps remained open. OS file cache/power state uncontrolled. UI assignment timestamps exclude physical render/scanout. App memory sampled every 100ms; child memory excluded.

runs.method: Real project registration, latest decoder and Slint software UI. Latency ends at image assignment on UI thread; excludes physical paint/scanout. 100ms settling between samples; first frame includes import/probe/registration.
